aim_assist.active_rule: mobile, (autoFireMbl || aimAssist), and a joystick held or a target already tracked

autofire.auto: shoot key held while on target; released buffer_ms after the last on-target frame
autofire.semi_auto: shoot key toggles every frame while the base box holds

box.rule: semi-auto (nAuto) weapon: fire when the target's projected body centre is inside the base box around the screen centre; any weapon: on target inside the box grown by grow_width / grow_height

pull.rule: look += aimAssistDist * innerWidth|innerHeight * factor * dt / look_mlt; factor = pull_initial until |dist.x| < center_threshold with no vertical pull, then pull_locked (vertical x locked_vertical_mlt unless the target is airborne); no vertical pull while the target's centre is within playerHeight*deadband_up/dist above .. deadband_down below the screen centre; while locked every look input is x locked_look_mlt

controls.look_formula: config.mouseSens * sens * (camera.fov / fov) * fw()  (1, or aim assist's locked_look_mlt while locked); pitch clamped to +-pitch_limit

aim_joystick.down: aim, and shoot unless auto-fire is on
